rationale: Roberts, as the assigning justice, is likely to write the majority opinion himself given the narrow 5-4 split and his stated preference for a remand-focused, institutionally cautious disposition that could attract broader agreement. Thomas is likely to write separately to express his originalist skepticism of the Mathews framework itself, while the liberal dissenters are likely to produce one or more dissents given the strength of their procedural asymmetry arguments.
